text:
Sanjay Rao: Heads up — we're trying to provision capacity for the Nebula pilot. Need quota increases and a billing/project approval to spin up nodes across multiple regions (us-west1, us-central1, europe-west4). Requested: H100 (4x), A100 (8x), L4 (12x), and 4x v4 TPUs. Also need static EIPs + egress quota for burst pools.
Alex Chen: do we have a billing project for Nebula yet or should we reuse sandbox-billing?
Sanjay Rao: we need a dedicated billing project (nebula-prod-test) so finance can track. Estimated monthly on-demand spend ~ $48k if we hit full burst. We plan to use preemptible/spot where possible to lower costs.
Maria Gomez: network checklist: will need VPC peering to infra-shared, reserved external IPs (8), and Cloud NAT for some clusters. Also firewall rules to allow node-port ranges. If we go cross-region we should confirm egress caps — GCP often requires explicit quota for inter-region egress.
Kate Bishop: +1 on dedicated billing project. Please add cost estimate + tag policy for all resources. I'll approve after finance signs off.
Sanjay Rao: filed the quota request form and opened a GCP support case. Case ID: CASE-2026-000123456. Linked the spreadsheet with region-by-region counts: https://docs.internal.redwood/nebula/quota-plan (internal).
ops-bot: GCP quota request submitted. Case CASE-2026-000123456. Current status: Pending Google review. Typical turn-around 24-72h.
Alex Chen: shared the IAM list: service account nebula-svc@nebula-prod-test.iam.gserviceaccount.com needs roles/compute.quotaAdmin and roles/owner on the billing project to complete provisioning.
Maria Gomez: quick command for reference if anyone needs to re-run capacity checks: ```gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=nebula-prod-test```
Sanjay Rao: one open question — do we want Dedicated GPUs in us-central1 for lower latency to our training infra, or concentrate in us-west1 for cost? Cost delta ~10% but latency better in us-central1. Thoughts?
Kate Bishop: prefer multi-region for redundancy. Put primary in us-west1, failover in us-central1. Keep europe-west4 smaller for EU customers.
Alex Chen: I'll prepare the billing project and set up budget alerts (thresholds: 10k, 25k, 40k) and send finance the cost breakdown.
Maria Gomez: also flagged a possible VPC-SC policy for europe-west4 — security team needs to confirm before we peer.
Sanjay Rao: thanks. I'll add the security review ticket and tag @kate. Once finance confirms, please ack here so I can reply to the GCP case with approvals.
Kate Bishop: finance gave conditional approval (email thread attached). I approve creating project and quota increases, pending we enable autoscaler safeguards and preemptible-first policy. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Rao: noted. Will add autoscaling policies and preemptible fallback. Replying to Google with approval now.
ops-bot: Google support updated CASE-2026-000123456 -> APPROVED_PARTIAL. H100 quota granted in us-west1: 4/4. A100 approved 6/8 in us-central1 (pending quota review). L4 approved 12/12 in europe-west4. TPU v4 request escalated.
Alex Chen: got it. For the partial A100, I'll update deployment plan to use A100 + L4 mix and fallback to L4 for non-latency-critical jobs.
Maria Gomez: provisioning checklist updated in the infra repo. Opening a follow-up thread for EIP allocation and firewall changes.
Sanjay Rao: great — thanks everyone. I'll close out once TPU escalation returns.
